sinopsis.es: Un adolescente sordo encuentra en el teatro y en una comunidad de artistas sordos una forma de expresar sus deseos y su dolor.
sinopsis.en: Marcelo, a deaf and LGBTQIAPN+ youth grieving the loss of his father, finds in a theater group with young deaf artists a possible path to transform his pain. Communicated entirely in Brazilian Sign Language (LIBRAS) and conceived from an aesthetic that prioritizes accessibility.
